snippet.title: IFSCL 13th Anniversary Trailer - Code Lyoko Game
snippet.description:
https://ifscl.org
https://ifscl.org/discord

13 years working on my ultimate fangame, probably my most ambitious video about it. It's time to tease my super ambitious story mode once more!
